subject: Approval request: deep-cut Hosted API discount for Acuity Labs (25% ask)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Discount request for Acuity Labs pilot – asking for exec approval (>20%)

Markus / Neha,

Quick one — Acuity Labs (SaaS data analytics, potential large private deployment in EU next year) is asking for a 25% off list on Hosted API for a 6-month pilot. Snapshot:
- Pilot: 6 months, expected month 1 usage ~150M tokens, ramp to ~750M tokens/month by month 6.
- Committed minimum spend: $40k/month for first 3 months, then true consumption billing with a forecasted blended ARR if expanded.
- Customer rationale: competitor parity + want to validate multi-region latency (they may move to Redwood Private later).

They explicitly want an up-front pricing concession to lock a pilot and get procurement moving. This is a >20% ask (25%). Deal desk flagged it as requiring exec approval because it's outside standard hosted discounts.

I've attached the usage forecast and draft SOW + redlines from their legal. Need a short signoff from you to offer 25% for the pilot with the conditional clauses below:
- 25% off list for first 6 months only; revert to standard pricing or negotiated tier post-pilot.
- Minimum committed spend must be signed into SOW before price becomes effective.
- Right to audit sample usage; no reseller rights; Redwood retains model-serving SLA.

If you want numbers: projected gross revenue over 6 months under 25% = ~$1.9M (consumption-driven). Finance will need to confirm margin math — tagging Laura.

Ben
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acuity_Usage_Forecast.xlsx, SOW_Acuity_Pilot_v1.pdf, Contract_redlines_Acuity.docx

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discount request for Acuity Labs pilot – asking for exec approval (>20%)

Ben — thanks. A few quick asks before I can greenlight:
1) Laura — can you confirm the incremental margin impact (assume current hosted unit economics) if we take 25% for the pilot? We need to ensure cost doesn't materially erode by >15% on gross margin.
2) Is there a clause we can add limiting long-term precedent? I don't want this to become a template for other mid-market pilots.
3) Neha — confirm likelihood this expands to Dedicated/Private in 12 months and whether we can include a one-time setup credit tied to that conversion.

If finance and customer success feel comfortable, I can approve a timeboxed concession. Tessa — if you can prep an approval memo with the conditions, I can sign.

Markus
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Markus — added quick notes and the customer's business case below. Also reattached the forecast.

Customer notes from today's call (Sofia Ramirez):
- Primary objective: validate Redwood latency/throughput for 5M calls/day; internal KPI = end-to-end inference latency <120ms.
- Strategic: if pilot looks good, they will commit to a 2-region Dedicated deployment in 2027 (potentially $200k+/mo).
- Procurement timeline: they need a signed SOW by 11/17 to hit their Q4 board approval.

Commercial ask: 25% off list for months 1–6, conditional on signed SOW and minimums. They will not accept anything less than 20% from competing vendors.

Operational ask we propose to include in the SOW:
- Timeboxed price concession clause (expires at month 7).
- Expansion credit: if they convert to Dedicated within 12 months, apply a one-time $50k migration credit (non-refundable).
- Pilot SLA: standard hosted SLA, with an added runbook and two-week joint tuning window.

Ben

Markus / Ben — ran the numbers on the attached forecast. Summary:
- Estimated gross revenue at list for 6 months: $2.53M. With 25% discount: $1.90M.
- Estimated variable costs (cloud + infra) for the 6-month pilot: ~$480k.
- Estimated contribution (gross margin) at 25% discount: ~$1.42M (~56%). At list price margin would be ~62%.
- Risk: first two months are low commitment then ramp — if customer under-delivers usage vs forecast, blended margin shrinks. Recommend requiring the minimum committed spend to be invoiced/guaranteed for months 1–3.

Recommendation: Finance is comfortable with a 25% concession for a 6-month pilot if the following are enforced:
1) Signed SOW with minimum invoiced commitment for months 1–3.
2) Price reverts to standard weighted tiering after month 6 unless a new agreement is signed.
3) Legal to include explicit no-precedent language and no resale clause.

If you want, I can draft a short finance memo for exec signoff.
